SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    products.category AS "order_items.products.category",
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.order_id) AS "order_items.orders_with_category"
  FROM order_items AS order_items
  LEFT JOIN products AS products
    ON order_items.product_id = products.id
  GROUP BY
    products.category
), _cm_order_items__order_id_count_distinct_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.order_id) AS "order_items.orders_with_items"
  FROM order_items AS order_items
), _cm_order_items__orders__id_count_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(orders.id) AS "orders.id_count_partition_by"
  FROM orders AS orders
)
SELECT
  _base."order_items.products.category",
  _base."order_items.orders_with_category",
  COALESCE(_cm_order_items__orders__id_count_partition_by."orders.id_count_partition_by", 0) AS "order_items.total_orders",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_order_items__order_id_count_distinct_partition_by."order_items.orders_with_items",
    0
  ) AS "order_items.orders_with_items"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_order_items__order_id_count_distinct_partition_by
CROSS JOIN _cm_order_items__orders__id_count_partition_by
ORDER BY
  _base."order_items.products.category" ASC
LIMIT 21
